request: safe read-only FF and dirty checks for 3 shared Host implementation roots

bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
REPORT=""
for ENTRY in 'CORE|/home/admin1/server-core' 'GATEWAY|/home/admin1/projects/webhook-gateway' 'TGSERVER|/home/admin1/projects/TGserver'; do
  NAME="${ENTRY%%|*}"
  ROOT="${ENTRY#*|}"
  CLEAN=NO
  FF=NO
  FETCH=NO
  if test -d "$ROOT/.git"; then
    if test -z "$(git -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"; then CLEAN=YES; fi
    if git -C "$ROOT" fetch --quiet --no-tags origin main 2>/dev/null; then
      FETCH=YES
      if git -C "$ROOT" merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD FETCH_HEAD; then FF=YES; fi
    fi
  fi
  REPORT="${REPORT}${NAME}_CLEAN=${CLEAN} ${NAME}_FETCH=${FETCH} ${NAME}_FAST_FORWARD=${FF} "
done
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/40/comments -f "body=CU40_HOST_REFLECT_PREFLIGHT: $REPORT" >/dev/null
printf 'CU40_REFLECT_PREFLIGHT_RECORDED=PASS\n'
